facts.text: John mentioned that his car broke down on Friday, which was part of a wild week that put a strain on his wallet.

evidence.quote: my car broke down last Fri on my way to work. Trying to get it fixed but it's tough & putting a strain on my wallet.

facts.text: John shared a photograph of a mountain with a sunset and flowers in the foreground, which reminded him of a road trip they took last year.

evidence.quote: This picture reminds me of a road trip we took last year; even with bumps along the way, there's still beauty and hope.

facts.text: John described the road trip as involving exploration of the coast in the Pacific Northwest and visits to some cool national parks.

evidence.quote: We explored the coast up in the Pacific Northwest and hit some cool national parks.
